purpose: Convert non-finite primary-optimizer trial points from unhandled analysis termination into auditable rejected trials while preserving the exact finite-domain CMLE objective and fail-closed final inference-readiness gates.

target_failure.exception: FloatingPointError: Conditional normalizer is non-finite for score 1.

baseline_contract.failure_localization: scipy BFGS Wolfe line search proposed an extreme point; _cmle_objective raised when a used-score conditional normalizer became non-finite

permitted_implementation_change.scope: primary BFGS optimizer adapter in fit_cmle plus typed telemetry and focused tests
permitted_implementation_change.finite_domain_objective: cmle_objective_value_grad and cmle_objective_value_grad_hessian remain unchanged for all inputs and continue to raise on non-finite mathematical evaluations when called directly
permitted_implementation_change.trial_rejection: The optimizer-only adapter may translate a non-finite value/gradient or FloatingPointError at a trial point into positive-infinity objective with a neutral finite gradient so the line search can reject/backtrack.
permitted_implementation_change.best_finite_fallback: Track the lowest finite objective point evaluated by the primary optimizer. If scipy terminates at a non-finite point, evaluate and continue from the tracked best finite point.
forbidden: clipping or changing model parameters inside the exact likelihood
changing response support, conditioning, offsets, anchors, constraints, or category probabilities
relaxing stationarity, rank, positive-definiteness, or covariance readiness gates
converting a non-finite or rank-deficient fit into inference-ready
silently changing estimator or falling back to MML/JMLE/approximate CMLE

focused_regression_contract.fixture: retained target RunId/scenario bytes plus a small deliberately separated binary Rater design
focused_regression_contract.target_expected: fit_cmle returns a complete result without an unhandled non-finite trial exception, records at least one invalid optimizer evaluation, and remains InferenceReady=False when final information/covariance requirements fail
focused_regression_contract.direct_objective_expected: A deliberately non-finite direct objective call still raises rather than being silently clipped.
focused_regression_contract.ordinary_fixture_expected: Existing complete RSM/PCM and hard-anchor fixtures retain estimates, SEs, likelihoods, rank, and readiness within their existing strict tolerances.

full_same_byte_replay.comparison_population: all 286 baseline-returned fits, with the target failure reported separately
comparison_fields: final gradient sup norm, information rank/nullity, condition number, and readiness
WLE estimate/SE, Infit, Outfit, raw either-upper flag, and three/six-decimal counterfactual flags
full_same_byte_replay.classification_gate: Every baseline-returned fit retains identical InferenceReady and every shared Person retains identical raw/rounded fit flags.
full_same_byte_replay.target_gate: The sole baseline exception becomes returned but not inference-ready, with invalid-evaluation telemetry greater than zero.

interpretation_limits.returnability: Returning a typed result is not convergence, finite-MLE existence, identifiability, or inference readiness.
interpretation_limits.invalid_trial_count: An optimizer diagnostic, not a statistical quality score or universal threshold.
interpretation_limits.separation: This remediation does not establish or implement a complete separation/nonexistence theorem for conditional MFRM likelihoods.
interpretation_limits.performance: No speed, recovery, coverage, anchor-share, or package-superiority claim.
